services.name: Personal Training
services.desc: Our personal trainers have one goal: to help you achieve yours. We match you with a trainer who doesn’t just fit your schedule, but also your style and vision. Your trainer will partner with you to create a fitness plan that works with your real life. Whether you’re brand new to working out or a seasoned athlete, progress isn’t linear, and challenges are inevitable. If you’re hitting a plateau, recovering from injury, learning a new physical skill, or striving to build functional strength, you don’t have to do it alone. services.desc: Located on our second floor, the XMF Studio is a dedicated space for group fitness, dance, and yoga classes led by top local instructors. Our studio is equipped with infrared heaters for a hot yoga experience that delivers deep muscle warming and easier breathing without the humidity of a traditional hot yoga class. XMF Studio classes are fun and challenging for all levels, and our teachers bring personality and creativity to every class. From heart-pumping cardio to laid-back line dancing, we pride ourselves in offering a wide range of class styles, so you can find your new favorite addition to your weekly schedule.
